en.title: B.R.V.S
en.decryption: Order of the Varna hierarchy established in the Purusha Sukta of the Rig Veda (later addition).

hi.title: B.R.V.S
hi.decryption: Order of the Varna hierarchy established in the Purusha Sukta of the Rig Veda (later addition).

fact.en: Confusing 'Varna' (social order) with 'Jati' (caste/lineage). Jati was not fully developed or rigid during this period.
fact.hi: Confusing 'Varna' (social order) with 'Jati' (caste/lineage). Jati was not fully developed or rigid during this period.

fact.en: Assuming Shudras were untouchable. Untouchability is a later Puranic/post-Vedic evolution, not a primary feature of 1000-600 BCE.
fact.hi: Assuming Shudras were untouchable. Untouchability is a later Puranic/post-Vedic evolution, not a primary feature of 1000-600 BCE.

fact.en: Believing tribal equality persisted. The later Vedic period saw the rise of 'Mahajanapadas' and hereditary chieftainships.
fact.hi: Believing tribal equality persisted. The later Vedic period saw the rise of 'Mahajanapadas' and hereditary chieftainships.
